findings.problem: coverage_gaps entry reads '...Post-ATC persistence (KB-021) và toàn bộ chuỗi Add-to-cart/APIOP-051 CHỈ xác nhận trên store2/SDK v1; store1/SDK v1 CHƯA tới được ATC...' — 'store2/SDK v1' is inconsistent with the rest of the document, which consistently maps store2 = SDK v2 and store1 = SDK v1. findings.problem: KB-018 is rated confidence HIGH with observed_count: 3. On inspection, the underlying causal claim ('skipping the grouped_clipart child click causes real ATC failure') rests on exactly ONE failed real-world attempt (all 3 grouped_clipart fields skipped together) and ONE successful real-world attempt (all 3 filled), i.e. one fail/success trial pair, cross-corroborated at two evidence layers (UI/DOM+banner, and network-level APIOP-051 absence/presence) rather than on 3 independently repeated trials. The direct DOM-level mechanism inspection (group reveals a required nested child sub-field) was isolated for only 1 of the 3 fields (Hairstyle); Cat Breed #1/#2 following the same pattern is inferred from the aggregate failed-attempt error text, not independently isolated. 'observed_count: 3' is technically counting evidence artifacts/refs, which could be misread downstream as 3 independently repeated trials.
findings.evidence: runs/context/2026-09-12/CTX-20260912-05/candidate/product-kb.json KB-018 (evidence_refs list has 6 entries spanning 1 fail attempt + 1 success attempt + 1 DOM sample + 1 API-map cross-check, not distinct repeated trials); cross-checked against storefront-evidence-store2-localstorage.json SF-OBS-005/010/011 and action-api-map.json APIOP-051.
findings.required_fix: Not a fabrication and not a scope-overreach (the item correctly restricts itself to store2/template 2/campaign 2595, does not claim template 1/3 or store1 behavior). Advisory only: qa-knowledge-normalizer should either (a) downgrade confidence to MEDIUM to reflect the single fail/success trial pair underlying the causal claim, or (b) keep HIGH but add an explicit note that the rating reflects cross-layer (UI+network) corroboration of one controlled trial pair rather than N independently repeated trials, so downstream consumers do not over-read 'HIGH' as 'repeatedly reconfirmed across many sessions'. Either fix is text-only; no new exploration required.
